title: incident-bot: surface on-call runbook & SLO quicklinks in diagnostics messages
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Reduce on-call triage time by surfacing authoritative quicklinks (runbook playbook URLs and SLO dashboards) directly in the incident-bot diagnostics and on-call messages. This PR integrates the slo-toolkit link resolver and a small runbook quicklink extractor so that automated diagnostics include clickable links to suggested runbooks and relevant SLO dashboards. Changes are backwards compatible: quicklinks are optional and disabled when no resolver is configured. Summary of changes: 1) Add integrations/slo-toolkit/resolver.go to resolve SLO dashboard links from SLO IDs and service metadata. 2) Implement runbook quicklink extractor in pkg/runbook/links.go that reads standard runbook metadata annotations. 3) Update diagnostics message formatter in pkg/handlers/diagnostics.go and the oncall message template (pkg/templates/oncall_message.tmpl) to include a Quicklinks section when links are available. 4) Add units (pkg/runbook/links_test.go, integrations/slo-toolkit/resolver_test.go) and an end-to-end test (ci/e2e/oncall_test.go) that asserts quicklinks are rendered for simulated alerts. 5) Update docs/web/ui/oncall/quicklinks.md describing the new feature and configuration steps. Checklist: - [x] implement resolver and extractor - [x] unit tests - [x] e2e test - [x] docs - [x] design review and approvals - [x] CI green (after rerun) Rollback strategy: revert feature-branch; quicklinks are opt-in and will not fail diagnostics if resolver is unavailable. Deployment notes: feature is server-side only; no client changes required. Configuration: optionally set SLO_TOOLKIT_ENDPOINT and RUNBOOK_STORE_URL in incident-bot config to enable resolvers.
